AboutMe.Title: About me
AboutMe.Paragraphs: I'm a frontend engineer based in Cairo, with 9+ years spent on large, long-lived products rather than one-off builds. I studied Computer Science at Zagazig University and started my career in 2019 building web and hybrid mobile applications.

Since June 2023 I've been at Netsync (Boston, remote), and since June 2025 I've been acting as Frontend Tech Lead — owning frontend architecture and engineering standards across delivery teams, and directly managing a team of six frontend developers.

Most of my work sits where architecture meets developer experience: structuring Nx monorepos and micro frontends, designing shared component libraries other teams depend on, and getting state management right with Signals, SignalStore, RxJS and NgRx. I also use Claude, Cursor and GitHub Copilot daily — as tools that speed up implementation, refactoring and test generation, under the same review standards as any other code.
Experience.Title: Where I've worked

Experience.Jobs.Title: Frontend Tech Lead / Senior Frontend Engineer
Description: Acting as Frontend Tech Lead since Jun 2025 — technical ownership of frontend architecture, engineering standards and technical decision-making across product delivery teams, directly managing a team of 6 frontend developers.
Lead end-to-end delivery from requirement breakdown and solution design through code review, implementation and deployment.
Architect and drive the implementation of micro frontends and Nx monorepos to structure scalable, maintainable enterprise applications.
Design reusable design systems and shared component libraries — dynamic forms, timeline UI primitives, enterprise grids — to keep UX consistent and accelerate cross-team delivery.

Architect Signal / SignalStore state management alongside RxJS and NgRx: feature-scoped stores, request deduplication, and API caching for dropdown and reference data to eliminate unnecessary re-fetching on component lifecycle.

Troubleshoot complex Nx dependency, build and lint issues; diagnose Node.js heap limits in large builds; configure SSR; set up Docker + Nginx deployments; resolve Cloud Run mixed-content issues; manage multi-backend endpoint environments.

Integrate Claude, Cursor and GitHub Copilot into daily engineering workflows for implementation, refactoring, debugging, test generation and architecture exploration, while holding the same quality bar.

FeatureProjects.Title: Selected work
FeatureProjects.Label: Case study

FeatureProjects.Projects.Title: Alto NX Platform
FeatureProjects.Projects.Description: An Nx monorepo hosting multiple Angular applications behind shared libraries for UI, utilities and core business logic. I architected the workspace structure and established the design system on top of PrimeNG, Tailwind CSS and AG Grid Enterprise, documented in Storybook.
FeatureProjects.Projects.Challenge: Keeping build stability and clear library boundaries while several teams ship into one workspace — and carrying the platform through Angular version modernizations without stalling delivery. Standalone components, OnPush and Signals / SignalStore underpin the runtime architecture; GraphQL, Docker and Husky the delivery side.

FeatureProjects.Projects.Title: Olympus Enterprise Frontend Platform
FeatureProjects.Projects.Description: Complex enterprise UI workflows for Timelines, Floors and structured data visualization, backed by scalable state management.
FeatureProjects.Projects.Challenge: Timeline and Floor management had to work as reusable components across multiple screens, each with a different business context driving the same interaction model — so the components needed to stay context-agnostic while the surrounding state stayed feature-scoped.

FeatureProjects.Projects.Title: Frontend Design System & Shared Libraries
FeatureProjects.Projects.Description: Standardized UI foundations consumed across products: PrimeNG wrappers, dynamic form components built on ControlValueAccessor, custom Timeline primitives, and reusable table/data-grid patterns with server-side pagination and filtering — all documented and developed through Storybook.
FeatureProjects.Projects.Challenge: Building form and grid primitives general enough for many teams to adopt without forking them, while keeping the public API small enough to stay maintainable.

FeatureProjects.Projects.Title: Alto / Designer / Signage — Multi-Application Architecture
FeatureProjects.Projects.Description: Multi-app integration across the Alto, Designer and Signage platforms while preserving backend and data boundaries between them.
FeatureProjects.Projects.Challenge: Engineering multi-environment launching so a single application version runs across distinct products and API environments — no per-product build, no forked configuration.

FeatureProjects.Projects.Title: Geidea POS
FeatureProjects.Projects.Description: Enterprise Point of Sale platform with real-time reporting and transaction tracking, built as a modular frontend with Angular, NgRx and micro frontends.
FeatureProjects.Projects.Challenge: Complex transactional workflows had to stay inside clear feature-domain boundaries, with state management and rendering tuned for large-scale POS usage.

FeatureProjects.Projects.Title: WinjiGo LMS
FeatureProjects.Projects.Description: Learning Management System serving the UAE Ministry of Education, covering student, parent and examination management portals.
FeatureProjects.Projects.Challenge: Delivering new Angular portals alongside an existing AngularJS and ASP.NET Core codebase, with both running in production.

FeatureProjects.Projects.Title: Meqati
FeatureProjects.Projects.Description: Cross-platform mobile application for Hajj and Umrah transportation and schedule management.
FeatureProjects.Projects.Challenge: Responsive interfaces and offline-ready behaviour on Ionic and Angular, for users with intermittent connectivity during pilgrimage travel.

FeatureProjects.Projects.Title: Health Heroes
FeatureProjects.Projects.Description: Cross-platform application for health management and Ministry services tracking.
FeatureProjects.Projects.Challenge: Delivering one consistent user experience across iOS and Android from a single Ionic and Angular codebase.
